test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, if RHYMES is coded as PFWKGQ, LIME is coded as JKKG, then what will CHIMES be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: 

 
• **Vowels **⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Consonants **⇒ (2) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• RHYMES is coded as PFWKGQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8330755fcb07f9da825944261d3a049315d4accb0617640b6f5eb991314e8740.png] 

And,

 
• LIME is coded as JKKG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7a5a33f50903afa5b74553806f4d2a1cf975b7d787cacadf2751076c5c084a3.png] 

Similarly,

 
• CHIMES will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d9c9e5dc8cd0d5ff4608f44e154935c0cb2e663d7f2196c63db160403f7ceee.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".
